question: Should Settings localization cover toolbar, quick-settings, section metadata, and schema/uiHint field labels under one frontend i18n contract, or should maintainers limit this issue to chrome-only Chinese copy and track schema labels separately?
rationale: The remaining behavior is real, but the schema-derived labels are not ordinary UI strings and the two open partial PRs already split the work in ways that need maintainer sequencing and API/product direction.

options.title: Define full Settings i18n contract
options.body: Localize Settings chrome, quick cards, section metadata, and schema/uiHint labels through generated locale keys with English fallback before sequencing PRs.

options.title: Land chrome-only slices first
options.body: Review partial PRs for toolbar and quick-settings copy while leaving schema-derived labels explicitly tracked as separate product/API work.

options.title: Move to broader UI localization tracker
options.body: Make the broader Control UI zh-CN issue canonical only if maintainers want one localization program to own all remaining tab text.

recommendation.title: Define full Settings i18n contract
recommendation.body: Localize Settings chrome, quick cards, section metadata, and schema/uiHint labels through generated locale keys with English fallback before sequencing PRs.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest current-main signal for the i18n pipeline and current Settings file history.
